subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should WebChat support a configurable Cmd/Ctrl+Enter send shortcut, and should that preference live in scoped browser UI settings, gateway/openclaw.json config, both surfaces, or neither?
rationale: The request adds user-facing shortcut and configuration/persistence behavior, and repository policy treats config/default additions and persisted preferences as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Review the linked PR path
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73390 as the implementation candidate after settling the settings owner, refreshing the branch, and preserving Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter behavior with tests.

options.title: Narrow to UI-local preference
options.body: Approve a browser-local scoped UiSettings preference and avoid adding openclaw.json operator config unless centralized deployment policy is explicitly needed.

options.title: Decline the new shortcut setting
options.body: Keep plain Enter-to-send plus Shift+Enter newline as the WebChat contract and close the linked PR and duplicate reports with that product rationale.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR path
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73390 as the implementation candidate after settling the settings owner, refreshing the branch, and preserving Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter behavior with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent current-file history and prior review context for the WebChat/settings decision surface.
